I would like to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team at Luar Vet Veterinary Clinic.

From the first contact via WhatsApp, I was received with great respect, attention, and professionalism. The secretaries were extremely attentive, answered all my questions clearly, provided transparent information about the costs of procedures, and demonstrated a welcoming attitude that is increasingly rare to find today.

A very special thank you to Dr. Arnaldo, an exceptional professional. Competent, confident, didactic, and extremely humane, he explains everything in simple and clear language, conveying great trust. Another point worth highlighting is his professional honesty: he does not request unnecessary tests, understanding that many families have financial limitations. His focus is, above all, the well-being of the animal, and not just profit. Furthermore, the clinic offers payment plans, demonstrating sensitivity towards pet owners.

Mel, who actually belongs to my sister, is 14 years old and underwent a tartar cleaning, a procedure that naturally made us apprehensive because of her age. However, everything was conducted with extreme care, responsibility, and affection. The anesthesiologist was excellent, the assistant was very careful in taking her to the procedure, and after the surgery, he was even kind enough to help her into the car, showing a kindness I will never forget.

It's clear that the entire team works with knowledge, competence, empathy, respect, and true love for their profession. At every stage, we felt that our Mel was being treated like a member of the family.

My gratitude will be eternal for all the care they gave her. I recommend Luar Vet Veterinary Clinic wholeheartedly to anyone looking for a serious, ethical, humane, and absolutely trustworthy place to care for their pet.

Congratulations to Dr. Arnaldo and this wonderful team. May they continue to be instruments of care, hope, and love in the lives of so many animals and their families.

Vana Oliveira (Ma. Aldivane)💙
